The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Reads the flag through one function (selector) with a short cache, defaulting to the safe state, and records who changed it and when
- States that a flag is a release control and not an authorisation check, and that it is removed once the rollout ends
- Keeps business logic in the service, with the flag only choosing which path runs, and adds tests for both states

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
